text:
Situation: Voriconazole 50 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 80 tablets (6.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 78 tablets (26.3 days) and can spare 36 tablets while retaining 14 days. Corvale General holds 342 tablets (21.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA’s drug shortage list shows voriconazole is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The product label identifies the manufacturing plant as Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3007373532) in India. FDA inspection records for that plant show an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2019-09-27 and a VAI classification after an inspection ending 2022-05-10. No FDA shortage posting exists to link those inspections to a current shortage.

Our position: No national shortage is declared. Local inventory at Corvale East is low. Internal transfer can mitigate the gap without purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 36 tablets of 50 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 99 tablets of 50 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchasing from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., AvPAK, or Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA at this time.
